what_this_is: The shared truth table for every predicate this project proves, in any language, on any chain.
why: There is no Compact-to-Noir bridge, so each predicate is implemented twice: once in Compact for Midnight, once in Noir for EVM and Solana. Two independent implementations of the same rule silently diverging is far more probable than any cryptographic break, and far harder to notice — a proof still verifies, it just proves something slightly different from what the other chain proved. These vectors are run against BOTH implementations in CI.
how_to_read: Each vector is (op, value, threshold) -> satisfied. The value is private in every case; the op and threshold are public.

vectors.note: boundary: at the threshold satisfies GTE
must be indistinguishable on chain from gte-above
zero is a real measurement, not an absent one
a threshold of zero is trivially met and must not error
boundary: at the threshold satisfies LTE
one row lost is not zero
the sealed-bid refusal, as a predicate
the top of Uint<64>: an implementation that overflows here fails silently

merkle_vectors.what_this_is: Inclusion proofs over the same committed set, so both implementations agree on leaf hashing, node hashing and odd-length trees.
merkle_vectors.node_scheme: sha256(0x01 || left || right); an odd node at a level is promoted unchanged
merkle_vectors.note: Odd-length trees are listed explicitly because a naive implementation drops the promoted node and still produces a plausible-looking root.
